mentions.name: Flowtelic
mentions.description: A workflow driven note-taking system that aims to get users thinking deeper and helps them figure out the most important next thing to work on when stuck, with plans for optional enhancement via a local-first AI approach.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Flowtelic. A workflow driven note-taking system that aims to get you thinking deeper, but also help you work on the most important thing next if you’re stuck. While not essential,  it’ll be enhanced with a local first AI approach.
